title: dance goes deeper than grunts & bending knees What of bees? or stars who gyrate at frequencies we can't see? We all chasing the same One An intergalac
summary: dance goes deeper than grunts & bending knees What of bees? or stars who gyrate at frequencies we can't see? We all chasing the same One An intergalactic stereophonic boogey oogey of poetry in bent sounds #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
dance goes
deeper than
grunts & bending
knees
What of bees?
or stars who gyrate
at frequencies
we can't see?
We all chasing the same
One
An intergalactic stereophonic
boogey oogey of poetry
in bent
sounds
#smallpoems
